## Specification

### Component: Select

A styled single choice. The trigger looks like an `Input`; options open in a floating listbox in the top layer. WAI-ARIA select-only combobox: DOM focus stays on the trigger, the highlight is `aria-activedescendant`.

#### Anatomy
```
<Select>                         context: value, open, registry, active option; hidden <input name> for forms
  <SelectTrigger>                <button role="combobox" class="ui-select-trigger">
    <SelectValue />              .ui-select-value (label of the selected option, or the placeholder)
    chevrons-up-down icon        .ui-select-icon
  <SelectContent>                .ui-floating.ui-listbox (popover="manual")
    <div role="listbox">         .ui-listbox-scroll (the scroller)
      <SelectGroup label>        role="group", .ui-listbox-group
        <SelectLabel />          .ui-listbox-label
        <SelectItem value />     .ui-option role="option" (+ .ui-option-check on the right)
      <SelectSeparator />        .ui-listbox-separator (decorative)
```
Shared listbox logic lives in `components/select/listbox.tsx` (Combobox and Multi-select import it).

#### Props
- `Select`: `value`, `defaultValue` (`''` = none), `onValueChange`, `open`, `defaultOpen`, `onOpenChange`, `name`, `form`, `disabled`.
- `SelectTrigger`: `size` (`sm` 32 · `md` 36 · `lg` 44), `placeholder`, native button props. Inside a `Field` it takes the id, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-required` and disabled state from `useFieldControl`.
- `SelectItem`: `value` (unique, non-empty), `disabled`, `textValue`.
- `SelectGroup`: `label`.

#### Behaviour
- Click opens the list (selected option highlighted); clicking again, Esc, Tab, blur or an outside press closes it. Focus stays on the trigger, also in Safari and Firefox (focus is set explicitly).
- Keyboard closed: Enter, Space, ArrowDown open on the selected option (else the first); ArrowUp opens on the selected (else the last); Home / End open on the first / last; a printable character opens and jumps to the first option starting with it.
- Keyboard open: ArrowDown / ArrowUp move (no wrap), Home / End, PageUp / PageDown (10), typeahead (500ms buffer, same letter repeated cycles), Enter or Space chooses and closes, Esc closes without change.
- Disabled options are skipped by the keyboard and ignore pointer input.
- The highlight follows the pointer (not touch). Keyboard movement scrolls the list, never the page.
- Pressing inside the list never moves focus (mousedown is prevented).
- While closed the options render in a hidden node so the trigger can show the selected label.
- `name` renders `<input type="hidden" name value>`.

#### Visual rules
- Trigger: same surface as `.ui-input` (border `--ui-border-strong`, `--radius-md`, `--ui-shadow-xs`, dark tint), height 32/36/44, padding-inline 10/12/16px, hover darkens the border (fine pointer only), focus-visible or open: border `--ui-ring` and a 3px ring at 25%. Invalid: `--ui-destructive` border. Disabled: opacity .5.
- Value text 14px, ellipsis; placeholder `--ui-muted-foreground`; chevrons icon 16px muted.
- Panel: `--ui-surface-raised`, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-lg`, padding 4px, `--ui-shadow-lg`, max-height `min(20rem, 100dvh - 1rem)`, min-width = trigger width, 6px below the trigger (flips above when there is no room).
- Option: min-height 32px, padding 4px 8px, `--radius-md`; highlighted `--ui-accent`; selected shows a 16px check on the right; disabled opacity .5.
- Group label 12px/500 muted; separator 1px `--ui-border`, full width.

#### Motion
- Open `ui-pop-in` 150ms `--ui-ease-out`, from 4px toward the trigger, scale .96, blur 2px. Close `ui-pop-out` 160ms `--ui-ease-in`, pointer events off.
- Check mark: opacity 150ms and scale .8 → 1 on `--ui-spring-snappy`.

#### Accessibility
- Trigger: `role="combobox"`, `aria-haspopup="listbox"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls` (while open), `aria-activedescendant`, named by the Field label or `aria-label`.
- List: `role="listbox"` named by the trigger; options `role="option"` + `aria-selected`; disabled `aria-disabled`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Opens below the trigger at least as wide as it; selected option highlighted and visible.
- Every key above works; focus never leaves the trigger; Esc keeps the value.
- Value shows its label before first open (`defaultValue`) and after choosing.
- Hidden input carries the value; the Field label focuses the trigger.
- axe clean in light and dark.

### `ui/components/select/listbox-utils.tsx`

```tsx
import { isValidElement, type ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Lowercase and strip diacritics, keeping a map from folded index → original index. */
export function fold(text: string) {
  let out = '';
  const map: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const f = (text[i] ?? '').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase();
    for (let k = 0; k < f.length; k++) map.push(i);
    out += f;
  }
  return { out, map };
}

/** Where `query` occurs in `text` (case and diacritic-insensitive), as [start, end) in `text`. */
export function matchRange(text: string, query: string): [number, number] | null {
  const q = fold(query.trim()).out;
  if (!q) return null;
  const { out, map } = fold(text);
  const at = out.indexOf(q);
  if (at < 0) return null;
  const start = map[at];
  const last = map[at + q.length - 1];
  if (start === undefined || last === undefined) return null;
  return [start, last + 1];
}

/** True when `text` contains `query` (an empty query matches everything). */
export function matchesQuery(text: string, query: string): boolean {
  if (!query.trim()) return true;
  return matchRange(text, query) !== null;
}

/** `text` with the part that matches `query` wrapped in <mark>. */
export function highlightMatch(text: string, query: string): ReactNode {
  const range = matchRange(text, query);
  if (!range) return text;
  return (
    <>
      {text.slice(0, range[0])}
      <mark className="ui-option-mark">{text.slice(range[0], range[1])}</mark>
      {text.slice(range[1])}
    </>
  );
}

/** Plain text of a React node (used for typeahead, filtering and chip labels). */
export function nodeText(node: ReactNode): string {
  if (node == null || typeof node === 'boolean') return '';
  if (typeof node === 'string' || typeof node === 'number') return String(node);
  if (Array.isArray(node)) return node.map(nodeText).join('');
  if (isValidElement(node)) return nodeText((node.props as { children?: ReactNode }).children);
  return '';
}
```

### `ui/components/select/listbox.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useId,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type MouseEvent,
  type PointerEvent,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import type { Placement } from '../../lib/position';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { usePresence } from '../../hooks/use-presence';
import { FloatingContent } from '../popover/floating-content';
import { fold } from './listbox-utils';

/* Shared listbox logic for Select, Combobox and MultiSelect ------------------
   Options are plain elements with role="option"; the keyboard owner (a button
   or an input) keeps DOM focus and points at the active option through
   aria-activedescendant. Options register their text so the closed control can
   still show a label (the list is rendered hidden while closed). */

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Option registry                                                            */

export interface OptionEntry {
  value: string;
  text: string;
  node: ReactNode;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export interface OptionRegistry {
  register: (entry: OptionEntry) => () => void;
  /** Keep the rendered label of an already registered option fresh (no re-render). */
  update: (value: string, node: ReactNode) => void;
  get: (value: string) => OptionEntry | undefined;
  entries: () => OptionEntry[];
  /** Changes whenever an option appears, disappears or changes its text. */
  version: number;
}

export function useOptionRegistry(): OptionRegistry {
  const map = useRef(new Map<string, { entry: OptionEntry; count: number }>());
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0);

  const register = useCallback((entry: OptionEntry) => {
    const current = map.current.get(entry.value);
    if (current) {
      current.count += 1;
      current.entry = entry;
    } else {
      map.current.set(entry.value, { entry, count: 1 });
    }
    setVersion((v) => v + 1);
    return () => {
      const c = map.current.get(entry.value);
      if (!c) return;
      c.count -= 1;
      if (c.count <= 0) map.current.delete(entry.value);
      setVersion((v) => v + 1);
    };
  }, []);

  const update = useCallback((value: string, node: ReactNode) => {
    const c = map.current.get(value);
    if (c) c.entry = { ...c.entry, node };
  }, []);
  const get = useCallback((value: string) => map.current.get(value)?.entry, []);
  const entries = useCallback(() => Array.from(map.current.values(), (c) => c.entry), []);

  return useMemo(() => ({ register, update, get, entries, version }), [register, update, get, entries, version]);
}

/** Register an option's label with the root so a closed control can display it. */
export function useRegisterOption(
  registry: OptionRegistry,
  value: string,
  text: string,
  node: ReactNode,
  disabled: boolean | undefined,
) {
  const { register, update } = registry;
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => register({ value, text, node, disabled }), [register, value, text, disabled]);
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    update(value, node);
  });
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Options in the DOM, active option, typeahead                               */

/** The enabled options inside a list, in document order. */
export function getOptions(list: HTMLElement | null): HTMLElement[] {
  if (!list) return [];
  return Array.from(list.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="option"]')).filter(
    (el) => el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true',
  );
}

/** Scroll the list (never the page) so `el` is fully visible. */
export function scrollOptionIntoView(el: HTMLElement) {
  const list = el.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-ui-listbox-scroll]');
  if (!list) return;
  if (getOptions(list)[0] === el) {
    list.scrollTop = 0;
    return;
  }
  const l = list.getBoundingClientRect();
  const r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
  const pad = 4;
  if (r.top < l.top + pad) list.scrollTop -= l.top + pad - r.top;
  else if (r.bottom > l.bottom - pad) list.scrollTop += r.bottom - (l.bottom - pad);
}

export type OptionTarget = 'next' | 'prev' | 'first' | 'last' | 'pageDown' | 'pageUp';

/** Which option gets highlighted when a list opens. */
export type OpenIntent = 'none' | 'selected' | 'selected-first' | 'selected-last' | 'first' | 'last';

/** The id of the highlighted option, plus keyboard movement through the list. */
export function useActiveOption(listRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>) {
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const activeRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
  const scrollRef = useRef(false);

  const activate = useCallback((id: string | null, scroll = false) => {
    activeRef.current = id;
    scrollRef.current = scroll;
    setActiveId(id);
  }, []);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!activeId || !scrollRef.current) return;
    scrollRef.current = false;
    const el = document.getElementById(activeId);
    if (el) scrollOptionIntoView(el);
  }, [activeId]);

  const move = useCallback(
    (target: OptionTarget) => {
      const options = getOptions(listRef.current);
      if (!options.length) return null;
      const index = options.findIndex((o) => o.id === activeRef.current);
      const last = options.length - 1;
      let next: number;
      switch (target) {
        case 'first':
          next = 0;
          break;
        case 'last':
          next = last;
          break;
        case 'next':
          next = index < 0 ? 0 : Math.min(last, index + 1);
          break;
        case 'prev':
          next = index < 0 ? last : Math.max(0, index - 1);
          break;
        case 'pageDown':
          next = index < 0 ? 0 : Math.min(last, index + 10);
          break;
        default:
          next = index < 0 ? last : Math.max(0, index - 10);
      }
      const option = options[next];
      if (option) activate(option.id, true);
      return option ?? null;
    },
    [listRef, activate],
  );

  /** Highlight the option an `intent` points at. Call once the list is rendered. */
  const highlight = useCallback(
    (intent: OpenIntent) => {
      const options = getOptions(listRef.current);
      const selected = options.find((o) => o.getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true');
      let target: HTMLElement | undefined;
      switch (intent) {
        case 'first':
          target = options[0];
          break;
        case 'last':
          target = options[options.length - 1];
          break;
        case 'selected':
          target = selected;
          break;
        case 'selected-first':
          target = selected ?? options[0];
          break;
        case 'selected-last':
          target = selected ?? options[options.length - 1];
          break;
        default:
          return;
      }
      if (target) activate(target.id, true);
    },
    [listRef, activate],
  );

  return { activeId, activeRef, activate, move, highlight };
}

/** Accumulates typed characters for 500ms. */
export function useTypeahead() {
  const buffer = useRef('');
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);
  const type = useCallback((char: string) => {
    clearTimeout(timer.current);
    buffer.current += char.toLowerCase();
    timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
      buffer.current = '';
    }, 500);
    return buffer.current;
  }, []);
  const pending = useCallback(() => buffer.current, []);
  return { type, pending };
}

/** The option whose text starts with `buffer`, searching on from the active one. */
export function findByText(list: HTMLElement | null, activeId: string | null, buffer: string): HTMLElement | undefined {
  const options = getOptions(list);
  if (!options.length) return undefined;
  const q = fold(buffer).out;
  const first = q[0] ?? '';
  const repeated = q.length > 1 && [...q].every((c) => c === first);
  const needle = repeated ? first : q;
  const index = options.findIndex((o) => o.id === activeId);
  const start = index < 0 ? 0 : needle.length === 1 ? index + 1 : index;
  for (let i = 0; i < options.length; i++) {
    const option = options[(start + i) % options.length];
    if (option && fold(option.textContent ?? '').out.trimStart().startsWith(needle)) return option;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Content                                                                    */

interface ListboxMeta {
  /** False when the list has no options (all filtered out): show an empty state. */
  hasOptions: boolean;
}
const ListboxMetaContext = createContext<ListboxMeta>({ hasOptions: true });

export function useListboxMeta() {
  return useContext(ListboxMetaContext);
}

export interface ListboxContentProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'role' | 'id'> {
  open: boolean;
  anchorRef: RefObject<Element | null>;
  /** id of the element with role="listbox". */
  listId: string;
  listRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  /** Content above the list (not part of the listbox), e.g. a selection summary. */
  header?: ReactNode;
  multiselectable?: boolean;
  placement?: Placement;
  offset?: number;
  matchWidth?: boolean;
  /** Runs once when the list has opened and is positioned. */
  onOpened?: () => void;
}

/**
 * The floating panel: a top-layer FloatingContent holding a scrollable
 * role="listbox". Pressing inside it never steals focus from the trigger or
 * input. While closed the options render in a hidden node so their labels stay
 * known to the root.
 */
export const ListboxContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ListboxContentProps>(function ListboxContent(
  {
    open,
    anchorRef,
    listId,
    listRef,
    header,
    multiselectable,
    placement = 'bottom-start',
    offset = 6,
    matchWidth = true,
    onOpened,
    className,
    children,
    onMouseDown,
    'aria-label': ariaLabel,
    'aria-labelledby': labelledBy,
    ...props
  },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const presence = usePresence<HTMLDivElement>(open);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, presence.ref);
  const [hasOptions, setHasOptions] = useState(true);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const list = listRef.current;
    if (list) setHasOptions(list.querySelector('[role="option"]') !== null);
  });

  const meta = useMemo(() => ({ hasOptions }), [hasOptions]);

  return (
    <>
      <FloatingContent
        ref={ref}
        open={open}
        anchorRef={anchorRef}
        placement={placement}
        offset={offset}
        matchWidth={matchWidth}
        className={cn('ui-listbox', className)}
        onMouseDown={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
          onMouseDown?.(e);
          e.preventDefault();
        }}
        onOpened={() => onOpened?.()}
        {...props}
      >
        {header}
        <div
          ref={listRef}
          id={listId}
          role={hasOptions ? 'listbox' : undefined}
          aria-multiselectable={multiselectable || undefined}
          aria-label={ariaLabel}
          aria-labelledby={labelledBy}
          data-ui-listbox-scroll=""
          className="ui-listbox-scroll"
        >
          <ListboxMetaContext.Provider value={meta}>{children}</ListboxMetaContext.Provider>
        </div>
      </FloatingContent>
      {!presence.mounted && (
        <div hidden>
          <ListboxMetaContext.Provider value={meta}>{children}</ListboxMetaContext.Provider>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Option                                                                     */

export interface ListboxOptionProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'onSelect' | 'id'> {
  optionId: string;
  value: string;
  selected: boolean;
  highlighted: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** `check` shows a tick on the right; `checkbox` a box on the left; `none` nothing. */
  indicator?: 'check' | 'checkbox' | 'none';
  /** Pointer or keyboard chose this option. */
  onChoose: () => void;
  /** Pointer moved over this option: highlight it. */
  onActivate: () => void;
}

/** A single role="option" row. Never focusable: the owner keeps focus. */
export const ListboxOption = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ListboxOptionProps>(function ListboxOption(
  {
    optionId,
    value,
    selected,
    highlighted,
    disabled,
    indicator = 'check',
    onChoose,
    onActivate,
    className,
    children,
    onClick,
    onPointerMove,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <div
      {...props}
      ref={ref}
      id={optionId}
      role="option"
      aria-selected={selected}
      aria-disabled={disabled || undefined}
      data-value={value}
      data-state={selected ? 'checked' : 'unchecked'}
      data-highlighted={highlighted ? '' : undefined}
      data-disabled={disabled ? '' : undefined}
      className={cn('ui-option', indicator === 'checkbox' && 'ui-option-with-box', className)}
      onPointerMove={(e: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onPointerMove?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented || disabled || e.pointerType === 'touch' || highlighted) return;
        onActivate();
      }}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented && !disabled) onChoose();
      }}
    >
      {indicator === 'checkbox' && (
        <span className="ui-option-box" aria-hidden="true">
          <Icon name="check" size={12} strokeWidth={2.5} />
        </span>
      )}
      <span className="ui-option-label">{children}</span>
      {indicator === 'check' && (
        <span className="ui-option-check" aria-hidden="true">
          <Icon name="check" />
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Group, label, separator, empty                                             */

const GroupContext = createContext<{ labelId: string; setHasLabel: (v: boolean) => void } | null>(null);

/** A group heading. Not selectable. */
export const ListboxLabel = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function ListboxLabel(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const group = useContext(GroupContext);
  const setHasLabel = group?.setHasLabel;
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    setHasLabel?.(true);
    return () => setHasLabel?.(false);
  }, [setHasLabel]);
  return <div ref={ref} id={group?.labelId} className={cn('ui-listbox-label', className)} {...props} />;
});

export interface ListboxGroupProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Heading for the group. Or render a label component as a child. */
  label?: ReactNode;
}

/** A labelled set of options. It hides itself when all its options are filtered out. */
export const ListboxGroup = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ListboxGroupProps>(function ListboxGroup(
  { label, className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const labelId = useId();
  const [hasLabel, setHasLabel] = useState(false);
  const ctx = useMemo(() => ({ labelId, setHasLabel }), [labelId]);
  return (
    <GroupContext.Provider value={ctx}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        role="group"
        aria-labelledby={hasLabel ? labelId : undefined}
        className={cn('ui-listbox-group', className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {label != null && <ListboxLabel>{label}</ListboxLabel>}
        {children}
      </div>
    </GroupContext.Provider>
  );
});

/** A thin divider between groups. Decorative. */
export const ListboxSeparator = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function ListboxSeparator(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} aria-hidden="true" className={cn('ui-listbox-separator', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** "No results" text. Shows only while the list has no options. */
export const ListboxEmpty = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function ListboxEmpty(
  { className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const { hasOptions } = useListboxMeta();
  if (hasOptions) return null;
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-listbox-empty', className)} {...props}>
      {children ?? 'No results found.'}
    </div>
  );
});
```

### `ui/components/select/select.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useId,
  useRef,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
  type MouseEvent,
  type MutableRefObject,
  type ReactNode,
  type RefObject,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useDismiss } from '../../hooks/use-dismiss';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';
import { useFieldControl } from '../field/field-context';
import {
  ListboxContent,
  ListboxGroup,
  ListboxLabel,
  ListboxOption,
  ListboxSeparator,
  findByText,
  useActiveOption,
  useOptionRegistry,
  useRegisterOption,
  useTypeahead,
  type ListboxContentProps,
  type ListboxOptionProps,
  type OpenIntent,
  type OptionRegistry,
} from './listbox';
import { nodeText } from './listbox-utils';

interface SelectContextValue {
  value: string;
  choose: (value: string) => void;
  open: boolean;
  setOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Open the list and highlight an option once it has rendered. */
  openWith: (intent: OpenIntent, typed?: string) => void;
  resolveOpen: () => void;
  disabled: boolean;
  triggerRef: RefObject<HTMLButtonElement | null>;
  listRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
  listId: string;
  registry: OptionRegistry;
  activeId: string | null;
  activeRef: MutableRefObject<string | null>;
  activate: (id: string | null, scroll?: boolean) => void;
  move: ReturnType<typeof useActiveOption>['move'];
}

const SelectContext = createContext<SelectContextValue | null>(null);

function useSelectContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(SelectContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <Select>.`);
  return ctx;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface SelectProps {
  /** Controlled value (`''` means nothing selected). */
  value?: string;
  /** Initial value when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string;
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  /** Controlled open state. */
  open?: boolean;
  defaultOpen?: boolean;
  onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;
  /** Submitted with the surrounding form under this name (via a hidden input). */
  name?: string;
  /** Associate the hidden input with a form by id. */
  form?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Select — a styled single choice list. The trigger is a button with
 * role="combobox" (the WAI-ARIA select-only combobox pattern); options live in
 * a floating listbox and are highlighted with aria-activedescendant, so DOM
 * focus never leaves the trigger.
 */
export function Select({
  value: valueProp,
  defaultValue = '',
  onValueChange,
  open: openProp,
  defaultOpen = false,
  onOpenChange,
  name,
  form,
  disabled = false,
  children,
}: SelectProps) {
  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState<string>({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onChange: onValueChange });
  const [open, setOpenState] = useControllableState({ value: openProp, defaultValue: defaultOpen, onChange: onOpenChange });
  const id = useId();
  const triggerRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const registry = useOptionRegistry();
  const { activeId, activeRef, activate, move, highlight } = useActiveOption(listRef);
  const intent = useRef<OpenIntent>('selected');
  const typed = useRef('');

  const setOpen = useCallback(
    (next: boolean) => {
      setOpenState(next);
      if (!next) activate(null);
    },
    [setOpenState, activate],
  );

  const openWith = useCallback(
    (nextIntent: OpenIntent, typedText = '') => {
      intent.current = nextIntent;
      typed.current = typedText;
      setOpen(true);
    },
    [setOpen],
  );

  const resolveOpen = useCallback(() => {
    if (typed.current) {
      const match = findByText(listRef.current, null, typed.current);
      typed.current = '';
      if (match) {
        activate(match.id, true);
        return;
      }
    }
    highlight(intent.current);
  }, [activate, highlight]);

  const choose = useCallback(
    (next: string) => {
      setValue(next);
      setOpen(false);
      // Safari and Firefox don't focus a button on click: keep focus on the trigger explicitly
      triggerRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
    },
    [setValue, setOpen],
  );

  return (
    <SelectContext.Provider
      value={{
        value,
        choose,
        open,
        setOpen,
        openWith,
        resolveOpen,
        disabled,
        triggerRef,
        listRef,
        listId: `${id}-list`,
        registry,
        activeId,
        activeRef,
        activate,
        move,
      }}
    >
      {children}
      {name && <input type="hidden" name={name} value={value} form={form} disabled={disabled} />}
    </SelectContext.Provider>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export type SelectSize = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

export interface SelectTriggerProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  /** Height: 32 / 36 / 44px. Default `md`. */
  size?: SelectSize;
  /** Text shown while nothing is selected (when you don't pass your own children). */
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Required for form validation styling and `aria-required`. */
  required?: boolean;
}

/** The control that shows the current value and opens the list. Looks like <Input>. */
export const SelectTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, SelectTriggerProps>(function SelectTrigger(
  { size = 'md', placeholder, className, children, id, required, disabled, onClick, onKeyDown, onKeyUp, onBlur, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ctx = useSelectContext('SelectTrigger');
  const control = useFieldControl({
    id,
    required,
    disabled,
    'aria-describedby': props['aria-describedby'],
    'aria-invalid': props['aria-invalid'],
  });
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, ctx.triggerRef);
  const typeahead = useTypeahead();
  const isDisabled = Boolean(control.disabled || ctx.disabled);

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
    onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (e.defaultPrevented || isDisabled) return;
    const key = e.key;
    const printable = key.length === 1 && !e.ctrlKey && !e.metaKey && !e.altKey;

    if (!ctx.open) {
      if (key === 'ArrowDown' || key === 'Enter' || (key === ' ' && !typeahead.pending())) {
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.openWith('selected-first');
      } else if (key === 'ArrowUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.openWith('selected-last');
      } else if (key === 'Home' || key === 'PageUp') {
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.openWith('first');
      } else if (key === 'End' || key === 'PageDown') {
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.openWith('last');
      } else if (printable) {
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.openWith('selected-first', typeahead.type(key));
      }
      return;
    }

    switch (key) {
      case 'ArrowDown':
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.move('next');
        return;
      case 'ArrowUp':
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.move('prev');
        return;
      case 'Home':
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.move('first');
        return;
      case 'End':
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.move('last');
        return;
      case 'PageDown':
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.move('pageDown');
        return;
      case 'PageUp':
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.move('pageUp');
        return;
      case 'Escape':
        e.preventDefault();
        ctx.setOpen(false);
        return;
      case 'Tab':
        ctx.setOpen(false);
        return;
      case 'Enter':
        e.preventDefault();
        if (ctx.activeRef.current) document.getElementById(ctx.activeRef.current)?.click();
        else ctx.setOpen(false);
        return;
      case ' ':
        if (!typeahead.pending()) {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (ctx.activeRef.current) document.getElementById(ctx.activeRef.current)?.click();
          else ctx.setOpen(false);
          return;
        }
        break;
    }
    if (printable) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const match = findByText(ctx.listRef.current, ctx.activeRef.current, typeahead.type(key));
      if (match) ctx.activate(match.id, true);
    }
  };

  return (
    <button
      {...props}
      ref={ref}
      type="button"
      role="combobox"
      id={control.id}
      aria-haspopup="listbox"
      aria-expanded={ctx.open}
      aria-controls={ctx.open ? ctx.listId : undefined}
      aria-activedescendant={ctx.open && ctx.activeId ? ctx.activeId : undefined}
      aria-describedby={control['aria-describedby']}
      aria-invalid={control['aria-invalid']}
      aria-required={control.required || undefined}
      disabled={isDisabled}
      data-state={ctx.open ? 'open' : 'closed'}
      data-placeholder={ctx.value === '' ? '' : undefined}
      className={cn('ui-select-trigger', size !== 'md' && `ui-select-trigger-${size}`, className)}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (e.defaultPrevented || isDisabled) return;
        ctx.triggerRef.current?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
        if (ctx.open) ctx.setOpen(false);
        else ctx.openWith('selected');
      }}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      onKeyUp={(e) => {
        onKeyUp?.(e);
        // Space clicks a button on keyup; the keydown already handled it
        if (e.key === ' ') e.preventDefault();
      }}
      onBlur={(e) => {
        onBlur?.(e);
        if (ctx.open) ctx.setOpen(false);
      }}
    >
      {children ?? <SelectValue placeholder={placeholder} />}
      <Icon name="chevrons-up-down" className="ui-select-icon" />
    </button>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface SelectValueProps {
  /** Shown while nothing is selected. */
  placeholder?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}

/** The selected option's label (or the placeholder). Goes inside <SelectTrigger>. */
export function SelectValue({ placeholder, className }: SelectValueProps) {
  const ctx = useSelectContext('SelectValue');
  const empty = ctx.value === '';
  return (
    <span className={cn('ui-select-value', className)} data-placeholder={empty ? '' : undefined}>
      {empty ? placeholder : ctx.registry.get(ctx.value)?.node}
    </span>
  );
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface SelectContentProps
  extends Omit<ListboxContentProps, 'open' | 'anchorRef' | 'listId' | 'listRef' | 'onOpened' | 'multiselectable' | 'header'> {}

/** The floating list. It is as wide as the trigger at least and sits in the top layer. */
export const SelectContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SelectContentProps>(function SelectContent(
  { 'aria-labelledby': labelledBy, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ctx = useSelectContext('SelectContent');
  const panelRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, panelRef);

  useDismiss(ctx.open, [panelRef, ctx.triggerRef], () => ctx.setOpen(false), { escape: false });

  return (
    <ListboxContent
      ref={ref}
      open={ctx.open}
      anchorRef={ctx.triggerRef}
      listId={ctx.listId}
      listRef={ctx.listRef}
      onOpened={ctx.resolveOpen}
      aria-labelledby={labelledBy ?? (ctx.triggerRef.current?.id || undefined)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface SelectItemProps
  extends Omit<ListboxOptionProps, 'optionId' | 'selected' | 'highlighted' | 'onChoose' | 'onActivate' | 'value' | 'indicator'> {
  /** The value this option stands for. Must be unique and non-empty. */
  value: string;
  /** Plain text for typeahead and the trigger when `children` isn't text. */
  textValue?: string;
}

/** One option. Shows a check when selected. */
export const SelectItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, SelectItemProps>(function SelectItem(
  { value, disabled, textValue, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useSelectContext('SelectItem');
  const id = useId();
  const text = textValue ?? nodeText(children);
  useRegisterOption(ctx.registry, value, text, children, disabled);
  return (
    <ListboxOption
      {...props}
      ref={ref}
      optionId={id}
      value={value}
      selected={ctx.value === value}
      highlighted={ctx.activeId === id}
      disabled={disabled}
      onChoose={() => ctx.choose(value)}
      onActivate={() => ctx.activate(id)}
    >
      {children}
    </ListboxOption>
  );
});

/** A labelled set of options: `<SelectGroup label="Europe">…</SelectGroup>`. */
export const SelectGroup = ListboxGroup;
/** A group heading, as a child of <SelectGroup>. */
export const SelectLabel = ListboxLabel;
/** A divider between groups. */
export const SelectSeparator = ListboxSeparator;
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-dismiss.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type RefObject } from 'react';

export type DismissReason = 'escape' | 'outside';

/**
 * Call `onDismiss` on Escape or a pointerdown outside every element in `refs`.
 * Used by popovers, menus, selects — anything non-modal that floats.
 */
export function useDismiss(
  enabled: boolean,
  refs: RefObject<Element | null>[],
  onDismiss: (reason: DismissReason) => void,
  { escape = true, outside = true }: { escape?: boolean; outside?: boolean } = {},
) {
  const cb = useRef(onDismiss);
  cb.current = onDismiss;
  const refsRef = useRef(refs);
  refsRef.current = refs;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (escape && e.key === 'Escape' && !e.defaultPrevented) {
        e.preventDefault();
        cb.current('escape');
      }
    };
    const onPointer = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as Node | null;
      if (!target) return;
      if (refsRef.current.some((r) => r.current?.contains(target))) return;
      cb.current('outside');
    };
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    if (outside) document.addEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
      document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', onPointer, true);
    };
  }, [enabled, escape, outside]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-presence.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { animationsFinished } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * Keeps an element mounted until its exit animation has finished.
 *   const { mounted, state, ref } = usePresence(open);
 *   {mounted && <div ref={ref} data-state={state} />}
 * CSS animates on [data-state="open" | "closed"]; nothing else is needed.
 */
export function usePresence<T extends Element = HTMLElement>(present: boolean) {
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(present);
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (present) {
      setMounted(true);
      return;
    }
    let cancelled = false;
    animationsFinished(ref.current).then(() => {
      if (!cancelled) setMounted(false);
    });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [present]);

  return {
    mounted: present || mounted,
    state: (present ? 'open' : 'closed') as 'open' | 'closed',
    ref,
  };
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

### `ui/lib/position.ts`

```ts
/* Pure positioning maths for floating panels (no DOM writes). */

export type Side = 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left';
export type Align = 'start' | 'center' | 'end';
export type Placement = Side | `${Side}-${Exclude<Align, 'center'>}`;

export interface Rect {
  left: number;
  top: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

export interface PositionOptions {
  placement?: Placement;
  /** Gap between anchor and panel, px. */
  offset?: number;
  /** Minimum distance from the viewport edge, px. */
  padding?: number;
  /** Flip to the opposite side when there is not enough room. */
  flip?: boolean;
}

export interface PositionResult {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  side: Side;
  align: Align;
  /** transform-origin pointing back at the anchor, e.g. "24px top". */
  origin: string;
}

const opposite: Record<Side, Side> = { top: 'bottom', bottom: 'top', left: 'right', right: 'left' };

export function computePosition(
  anchor: Rect,
  panel: { width: number; height: number },
  viewport: { width: number; height: number },
  { placement = 'bottom-start', offset = 6, padding = 8, flip = true }: PositionOptions = {},
): PositionResult {
  const [rawSide, rawAlign] = placement.split('-') as [Side, Align | undefined];
  let side = rawSide;
  const align: Align = rawAlign ?? 'center';
  const a = { ...anchor, right: anchor.left + anchor.width, bottom: anchor.top + anchor.height };

  const space: Record<Side, number> = {
    top: a.top,
    bottom: viewport.height - a.bottom,
    left: a.left,
    right: viewport.width - a.right,
  };
  const vertical = side === 'top' || side === 'bottom';
  const need = (vertical ? panel.height : panel.width) + offset;
  if (flip && space[side] < need && space[opposite[side]] > space[side]) side = opposite[side];

  let x: number;
  let y: number;
  if (side === 'top' || side === 'bottom') {
    y = side === 'bottom' ? a.bottom + offset : a.top - panel.height - offset;
    x = align === 'start' ? a.left : align === 'end' ? a.right - panel.width : a.left + a.width / 2 - panel.width / 2;
  } else {
    x = side === 'right' ? a.right + offset : a.left - panel.width - offset;
    y = align === 'start' ? a.top : align === 'end' ? a.bottom - panel.height : a.top + a.height / 2 - panel.height / 2;
  }

  // Shift into the viewport
  x = Math.max(padding, Math.min(x, viewport.width - panel.width - padding));
  y = Math.max(padding, Math.min(y, viewport.height - panel.height - padding));

  const clamp = (v: number, max: number) => Math.round(Math.min(Math.max(v, 0), max));
  const ox = side === 'left' ? 'right' : side === 'right' ? 'left' : `${clamp(a.left + a.width / 2 - x, panel.width)}px`;
  const oy = side === 'top' ? 'bottom' : side === 'bottom' ? 'top' : `${clamp(a.top + a.height / 2 - y, panel.height)}px`;

  return { x: Math.round(x), y: Math.round(y), side, align, origin: `${ox} ${oy}` };
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/select.css`

```css
/* Select + shared listbox ---------------------------------------------------
   Trigger (looks like .ui-input):
   <button class="ui-select-trigger [ui-select-trigger-sm|lg]" role="combobox" aria-expanded data-state>
     <span class="ui-select-value" [data-placeholder]>…</span>
     <svg class="ui-select-icon">
   Floating list (also used by Combobox and Multi-select):
   <div class="ui-floating ui-listbox" popover="manual" data-state data-side>
     optional header (outside the listbox)
     <div class="ui-listbox-scroll" role="listbox">
       .ui-listbox-group > .ui-listbox-label
       .ui-option [role=option] [aria-selected] [data-highlighted] [data-disabled]
          .ui-option-box (checkbox variant, .ui-option-with-box)  .ui-option-label  .ui-option-check
       .ui-listbox-separator   .ui-listbox-empty
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  /* ---- Trigger -------------------------------------------------------- */
  .ui-select-trigger {
    --ui-input-bg: var(--ui-background);
    --ui-input-border: var(--ui-border-strong);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    height: var(--ui-input-h, 2.25rem);
    padding-inline: var(--ui-input-px, 0.75rem);
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-input-border);
    border-radius: var(--ui-input-r, var(--radius-md));
    background-color: var(--ui-input-bg);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: var(--ui-input-fs, var(--text-base));
    text-align: start;
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-xs);
    cursor: pointer;
    outline: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition:
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  :where(.dark, [data-theme-mode="dark"]) .ui-select-trigger {
    --ui-input-bg: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 5%, transparent);
    box-shadow: none;
  }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-select-trigger:hover:not(:disabled, [aria-invalid="true"], [aria-expanded="true"]) {
      --ui-input-border: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-border-strong) 55%, var(--ui-foreground));
    }
  }

  .ui-select-trigger:focus-visible,
  .ui-select-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] {
    --ui-input-border: var(--ui-ring);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-select-trigger[aria-invalid="true"] { --ui-input-border: var(--ui-destructive); }
  .ui-select-trigger[aria-invalid="true"]:focus-visible,
  .ui-select-trigger[aria-invalid="true"][aria-expanded="true"] {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 25%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-select-trigger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

  .ui-select-trigger-sm { --ui-input-h: 2rem; --ui-input-fs: var(--text-sm); --ui-input-px: 0.625rem; }
  .ui-select-trigger-lg { --ui-input-h: 2.75rem; --ui-input-fs: var(--text-md); --ui-input-px: 1rem; --ui-input-r: var(--radius-lg); }

  .ui-select-value {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-width: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ui-select-value[data-placeholder] { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  .ui-select-icon {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  /* ---- Floating list (shared) ----------------------------------------- */
  .ui-listbox {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: max-content;
    min-width: 8rem;
    max-width: calc(100vw - 1rem);
    max-height: min(20rem, calc(100dvh - 1rem));
    padding: 4px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-lg);
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-listbox[data-state="open"] { animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out) both; }
  .ui-listbox[data-state="closed"] { animation: ui-pop-out var(--ui-duration-exit) var(--ui-ease-in) both; pointer-events: none; }

  .ui-listbox-scroll {
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow-y: auto;
    overscroll-behavior: contain;
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    outline: none;
  }

  /* ---- Options -------------------------------------------------------- */
  .ui-option {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    min-height: 2rem;
    padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: inherit;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    cursor: default;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    outline: none;
  }
  .ui-option[data-highlighted] {
    background: var(--ui-accent);
    color: var(--ui-accent-foreground);
  }
  .ui-option[data-disabled] { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

  .ui-option-label { flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-option-label > svg:first-child { margin-inline-end: 0.5rem; vertical-align: -0.1875rem; }

  .ui-option-check {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-inline-start: auto;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.8);
    transition:
      opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out),
      transform var(--ui-spring-snappy-duration) var(--ui-spring-snappy);
  }
  .ui-option-check > svg { width: 1rem; height: 1rem; }
  .ui-option[aria-selected="true"] > .ui-option-check { opacity: 1; transform: none; }

  /* Checkbox variant (multi-select) */
  .ui-option-box {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 1rem;
    height: 1rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border-strong);
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: var(--ui-background);
    color: transparent;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-option[aria-selected="true"] > .ui-option-box {
    border-color: var(--ui-control-on);
    background: var(--ui-control-on);
    color: var(--ui-control-glyph);
  }

  /* The part of an option that matches what was typed */
  .ui-option-mark {
    padding: 0;
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 12%, transparent);
    color: inherit;
    font-weight: 500;
  }

  /* ---- Groups, labels, separators, empty ------------------------------ */
  .ui-listbox-group:not(:has([role="option"])) { display: none; }
  .ui-listbox-label {
    padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1rem;
    font-weight: 500;
  }
  .ui-listbox-separator { height: 1px; margin: 4px -4px; background: var(--ui-border); }
  .ui-listbox-empty {
    padding: 0.75rem 0.5rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    text-align: center;
  }

  /* iOS Safari only dispatches click on elements that look clickable */
  @media (hover: none) {
    .ui-option { cursor: pointer; }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Time zone** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/select/timezone.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { Field, FieldHint, Label } from '@/ui/components/field';
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectGroup, SelectItem, SelectSeparator, SelectTrigger } from '@/ui/components/select';

export default function SelectTimezone() {
  return (
    <Field className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <Label>Time zone</Label>
      <Select name="timezone" defaultValue="Europe/London">
        <SelectTrigger placeholder="Select a time zone" />
        <SelectContent>
          <SelectGroup label="Europe">
            <SelectItem value="Europe/London">London (GMT+0)</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="Europe/Berlin">Berlin (GMT+1)</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="Europe/Athens">Athens (GMT+2)</SelectItem>
          </SelectGroup>
          <SelectSeparator />
          <SelectGroup label="North America">
            <SelectItem value="America/New_York">New York (GMT-5)</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="America/Chicago">Chicago (GMT-6)</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="America/Denver">Denver (GMT-7)</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="America/Los_Angeles">Los Angeles (GMT-8)</SelectItem>
          </SelectGroup>
          <SelectSeparator />
          <SelectGroup label="Asia and Pacific">
            <SelectItem value="Asia/Dubai">Dubai (GMT+4)</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="Asia/Kolkata">Mumbai (GMT+5:30)</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="Asia/Tokyo">Tokyo (GMT+9)</SelectItem>
            <SelectItem value="Australia/Sydney">Sydney (GMT+11)</SelectItem>
          </SelectGroup>
        </SelectContent>
      </Select>
      <FieldHint>Meeting invites and digests use this time zone.</FieldHint>
    </Field>
  );
}
```
